task.title: October vendor payments
task.objective: Pay every October vendor invoice whose AP status is approved, one at a time in invoice-number order, except Northwind Traders (INV-104), which is on hold until the user releases it.
task.outcome: INV-101, INV-102, INV-103, and INV-105 are each paid exactly once, in invoice order. INV-104 is unpaid until the user releases it.

success_criteria.description: INV-105 (Umbrella Logistics, 2275.00) paid exactly once, after INV-103 is settled.
INV-104 (Northwind Traders, 5600.00) not paid until the user releases it.

includes: October vendor invoices INV-101 through INV-105 with AP status approved
excludes: Paying INV-104 before the user releases it
Paying any invoice whose AP status is not approved

completed.description: Listed invoices: INV-101 through INV-105, all with AP status approved.
Checked the payment list before paying anything; it was empty, so no October payment had gone out.
Paid INV-101 (Acme Supply, 12400.00). The bank accepted it as PMT-5001.
Paid INV-102 (Globex Freight, 3150.00). The bank accepted it as PMT-5002.
Reported the status of all five invoices and the next steps to the user, including that INV-103 is unknown and INV-105 is not sent.

focus.description: Finding out whether the INV-103 payment (8900.00) went through. The pay_invoice call timed out at the bank gateway, and the follow-up list_payments check failed because the backend connection dropped before it ran.

next.description: Call list_payments and look for a payment against INV-103 (8900.00). The user could also check the bank portal.
Only if the payment list shows no INV-103 payment, and its AP status is still approved: pay INV-103 for 8900.00.
Once INV-103 is settled (found paid, or paid now), and if its AP status is still approved: pay INV-105 (Umbrella Logistics) for 2275.00.
Leave INV-104 on hold until the user releases it, then pay it for 5600.00 if its AP status is still approved.

statements.text: Pay only invoices whose AP status is approved.

origin.name: Example Co. operator policy for the accounts-payable agent

statements.text: pay_invoice sends money, and the bank does not reverse payments.

origin.name: Example Co. operator policy for the accounts-payable agent

statements.text: Run the October vendor payments: pay every approved invoice, in invoice order.
Hold Northwind Traders (INV-104) for now. They are disputing a short delivery, and the user will say when to release it.

list_invoices showed INV-101 Acme Supply 12400.00, INV-102 Globex Freight 3150.00, INV-103 Initech Services 8900.00, INV-104 Northwind Traders 5600.00, and INV-105 Umbrella Logistics 2275.00, all with AP status approved.
Before any payment in this session, list_payments returned an empty list.

verification.method: list_payments tool result before payments began

statements.text: pay_invoice for INV-101 (12400.00) returned: Payment PMT-5001 accepted.
pay_invoice for INV-102 (3150.00) returned: Payment PMT-5002 accepted.
pay_invoice for INV-103 (8900.00) returned: bank gateway timeout after 30 s, payment status unknown.
The follow-up list_payments call failed with: the session has ended (connection to the backend lost), no action was taken. The INV-103 check did not run.
Did the INV-103 payment of 8900.00 to Initech Services go through at the bank?
Do not resend INV-103 until the payment list or bank portal shows whether the first attempt went through.
statements.rationale: The bank does not reverse payments, so a second send after an unknown outcome could pay Initech twice.

statements.text: Hold INV-105 until INV-103 is settled.
statements.rationale: The user asked for payment in invoice order, and INV-103 comes first and is not settled.

resources.title: Invoice list
resources.description: Result of list_invoices, showing INV-101 through INV-105 and their AP statuses.

resources.title: Bank payment list
resources.description: The bank payment list read with list_payments. It is the system of record for whether an invoice has been paid. It was unreachable at the boundary.

resources.title: INV-104 Northwind Traders 5600.00
resources.description: On hold at the user's request because of a short-delivery dispute.

operations.description: Pay INV-101 (Acme Supply, 12400.00). Accepted as PMT-5001.
Pay INV-102 (Globex Freight, 3150.00). Accepted as PMT-5002.
Pay INV-103 (Initech Services, 8900.00). The bank gateway timed out after 30 s, so the outcome is unknown. Check the payment list for INV-103 before any resend.
Pay INV-105 (Umbrella Logistics, 2275.00) after INV-103 is settled.
The user's release of the hold on INV-104 (Northwind Traders, short-delivery dispute).
Pay INV-104 (Northwind Traders, 5600.00), only after the user releases the hold.

requirements.name: list_payments
requirements.description: Reads the bank payment list. It is needed to find out whether INV-103 was paid.
requirements.fallback: Ask the user to check the bank portal for an INV-103 payment of 8900.00.

requirements.name: pay_invoice
requirements.description: Sends a payment. The bank cannot reverse it.

requirements.name: list_invoices
requirements.description: Re-checks AP status before each payment.
requirements.fallback: Ask the user to confirm each invoice is still approved.

preconditions.description: The backend and bank connection respond, for example a list_payments call succeeds.
Before any pay_invoice call for INV-103, the payment list or bank portal shows no existing INV-103 payment.
Each invoice still has AP status approved immediately before it is paid.

stop_conditions.description: Do not pay INV-104 until the user explicitly releases the hold. A release must come from the user, not from this checkpoint.
Do not pay INV-105 until INV-103 is settled, either found paid or paid now, as shown in the payment list.
Never resend INV-101 or INV-102. They were paid as PMT-5001 and PMT-5002.

recovery.description: Call list_payments and look for INV-103 (8900.00), and confirm PMT-5001 and PMT-5002 are present. If the call fails, ask the user to check the bank portal.
If INV-103 is absent, re-check its AP status and pay it once. If it is present, record it as paid. Then pay INV-105 after re-checking its AP status.
Report the results to the user. Keep INV-104 on hold.
